plain_english: To you I bow — you conjure the churned stupor of becoming, then shatter it: bliss of gnosis, no pairs — O god, veiler and unveiler.
sanskrit_cite: namas te bhavasambhrāntabhrāntim udbhāvya bhindate jñānānandaṃ ca nirdvandvaṃ deva vṛtvā vivṛṇvate

plain_english: What longings could sound her farthest shore — her who filches glamour in a single blink? Śiva, keep us.
sanskrit_cite: yasyāḥ prāpyeta paryantaviśeṣaḥ kair manorathaiḥ māyām ekanimeṣeṇa muṣṇaṃs tāṃ pātu naḥ śivaḥ

plain_english: Freedom's hard road, wisdom's high crown, hunger's last ridge — their bearer, lord, is you.
sanskrit_cite: vairāgyasya gatiṃ gurvīṃ jñānasya paramāṃ śriyam naiḥspṛhyasya parāṃ koṭiṃ bibhratāṃ tvaṃ prabho prabhuḥ

plain_english: Brahmā himself has Brahmā in you; what master owns no master in you, master of masters? Bliss of the world's bliss — who gauges how huge you are?
sanskrit_cite: brahmaṇo 'pi bhavān brahma kasya neśas tvam īśituḥ jagatkalyāṇakalyāṇaṃ kiyat tvam iti vetti kaḥ

plain_english: Kinsmen avail what, comrades what, patrons what? My lord, in every strait it is you who hauls us off the sea of birth.
sanskrit_cite: kim anyair bandhubhiḥ kiṃ ca suhṛdbhiḥ svāmibhis tathā sarvasthāne mameśa tvaṃ ya uddhartā bhavārṇavāt

plain_english: Hail the heaven-dew beads — hauled by discipline's force, strong to rinse folly, glamour, grime.
sanskrit_cite: jayanti mohamāyādimalasaṃkṣālanakṣamāḥ śaivayogabalākṛṣṭā divyapīyūṣavipruṣaḥ

plain_english: The chant hymns his thought-kindling blaze — O may he urge our minds down the straight track, our lord.
sanskrit_cite: gāyatryā gīyate yasya dhiyāṃ tejaḥ pracodakam codayed api kaccin naḥ sa dhiyaḥ satpathe prabhuḥ

plain_english: Eight-bodied one — in one body at least, grant us ground that holds; or glad-hearted, grant us everything.
sanskrit_cite: aṣṭamūrte kim ekasyām api mūrtau na naḥ sthitim śāśvatīṃ kuruṣe yad vā tuṣṭaḥ sarvaṃ kariṣyasi

plain_english: Things prove their truth by work they do — but your bare name, lord, perfects through to release.
sanskrit_cite: vastutattvaṃ padārthānāṃ prāyeṇārthakriyākaram bhavatas tv īśa nāmāpi mokṣaparyantasiddhidam

plain_english: Stage after stage you reset the painted world, ever and again — lord, at that craft of yours, what keen heart is not stunned?
sanskrit_cite: muhur muhur jagaccitrasy-ānyānyāṃ sthitim ūhitum śaktir yā te tayā nātha ko manasvī na vismitaḥ

plain_english: Make the hard handy and sweeten the bitter — his memory alone is valiant: him we mind, the lover's bane.
sanskrit_cite: duṣkaraṃ sukarīkartuṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhayituṃ tathā ekavīrā smṛtir yasya taṃ smarāmaḥ smaradviṣam

plain_english: Long live the hymns that sing the high lord — at whose bare name the great break out in bristling thrill.
sanskrit_cite: jayanti gītayo yāsāṃ sa geyaḥ parameśvaraḥ yannāmnāpi mahātmānaḥ kīryante pulakāṅkuraiḥ

plain_english: Were you as you are, O Becoming, in the beyond — your hosts of power marshalled to launch and close the triple world.
sanskrit_cite: bhavān iva bhavān eva bhaved yadi paraṃ bhava svaśaktivyūhasaṃvyūḍhatrailokyārambhasaṃhṛtiḥ

plain_english: Spell you are, spell-fit you are, spell-master — what second wizard besides you? Come, hand me that spell, lord, that I turn spellbound to you.
sanskrit_cite: mantro 'si mantraṇīyo 'si mantrī tvattaḥ kuto 'paraḥ sa mahyaṃ dehi taṃ mantraṃ tvanmantraḥ syāṃ yathā prabho

plain_english: Light-shaped, vow-true — the self in you is mine, am I: yet called a drifter — O lord, what dream is this, and how in you?
sanskrit_cite: bhārūpaḥ satyasaṃkalpas tvam ātmā yasya so 'py aham saṃsārīti kim īśaiṣa svapnaḥ so 'pi kutas tvayi

plain_english: Unsnapped, unchurlish, single, sound — in you, lord, stands the fortune of men who stake their harvest on you.
sanskrit_cite: tad abhaṅgi tad agrāmyaṃ tad ekam upapattimat tvayi karmaphalanyāsakṛtām aiśvaryam īśa yat

plain_english: Strong to crush what ills, to deal what boons — or not? Here he is, our darling, god of gods on the bull-flag.
sanskrit_cite: kṣamaḥ kāṃ nāpadaṃ hantuṃ kāṃ dātuṃ sampadaṃ na vā yo 'sau sa dayito 'smākaṃ devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ

plain_english: For god-sight filmed with inborn stain, lord, your love is the last salve that rinses clean.
sanskrit_cite: māyāmayamalāndhasya divyasya jñānacakṣuṣaḥ nirmalīkaraṇe nātha tvadbhaktiḥ paramāñjanam

plain_english: Fear-free, bliss-full, one, unwasting — plant that foothold in me, come, god — quick, why linger?
sanskrit_cite: nirbhayaṃ yad yad ānandamayam ekaṃ yad avyayam padaṃ dehy ehi me deva tūrṇaṃ tat kiṃ pratīkṣase

plain_english: Ah, bottomless and grim, the drowning sea of rounds; ah, to ferry it — some high one — great Master.
sanskrit_cite: aho nisargagambhīro ghoraḥ saṃsārasāgaraḥ aho tattaraṇopāyaḥ paraḥ ko 'pi maheśvaraḥ
